explanation: I found no Mathlib match. `adicallyRestrictedSubring` and `IsAdicallyRestricted` are the library's own definitions, in `FormalPowerSeries/MvPowerSeries/IdealAdicRestricted.lean`. The proof only goes through the library's own membership lemma and its `IsAdicallyRestricted.mono`, so the mathematical content is entirely in the library's definitions. The closest thing in Mathlib is `RingTheory/MvPowerSeries/Restricted.lean` and `RingTheory/PowerSeries/Restricted.lean`, which define restricted power series by a norm/convergence condition (`IsRestricted c f`), not ideal-adically. Mathlib has no ideal-adic version of the restricted subring and no monotonicity lemma for one. I grepped Mathlib's RingTheory directory for `adicallyRestricted`, `IsRestricted` and `isRestricted`.
